jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
We’re looking for a highly creative, entrepreneurial, and organized Manager, Startup Marketing to expand MongoDB’s AI-native marketing strategy and strengthen our presence across the startup and AI/Digital-Native ecosystem in India. The role reports to the Head of India Marketing and will be part of the International Marketing organisation. 
 This role combines strategy and execution, with a focus on ecosystem engagement, community building, and scalable startup programming. You will help strengthen MongoDB’s presence among high-growth, venture-backed startups across India by building relationships with founders, venture capital firms, accelerators, and startup communities. In partnership with the broader  marketing team, you will design and execute programs, events, and partnerships that increase awareness, adoption, and long-term affinity for MongoDB. As a regional representative for MongoDB, you will support the planning and delivery of startup-focused initiatives such as hackathons, demo nights, founder dinners, and conference-adjacent activations. This role sits at the intersection of partnerships, community, events, regional marketing, and content, and requires someone who is equally comfortable shaping ideas and driving hands-on execution. 
 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. 
 Position Expectations 
 Serve as one of the MongoDB representatives within the India startup ecosystem: Build and maintain strong relationships across the India startup community, including founders, operators, VCs, accelerators, and key ecosystem partnersDrive high-value startup acquisition: Develop and execute a targeted strategy to engage and convert high-potential startups in the region into the MongoDB for Startups programExpand MongoDB’s physical presence in India: In partnership with broader India marketing team, develop and execute a regional event strategy focused on high-impact founder programming, including VC-partnered events, demo days, hackathons, founder dinners, and other community activationsPartner with startups to highlight success: Work with internal teams and startup customers to surface and develop compelling stories showcasing startups building on MongoDB 
 
 Own cross-functional alignment for the regional startup audience: Collaborate with teams such as MongoDB Ventures, Regional Marketing, Strategic Events, Sales, and Builder Relations to integrate startup-focused programming and ensure regional initiatives effectively reach founders and developers 
 Measure impact and continuously optimize: Monitor and track success metrics for startup engagement, such as attendance quality, funded-founder participation, and program applications, and use insights to refine strategy and programming 
 
 The right candidate for this role will be: 
 
 Have 4+ years of experience in marketing, community, ecosystem, or events roles focused on startups, developers, or technical founders 
 Have experience leading projects or programs and collaborating across teams, with the ability to drive initiatives from strategy through execution  
 Possess familiarity with the Indian startup ecosystem, ideally with relationships across founders, VCs, accelerators, and key founder communities 
 Have experience working in or closely with startups or venture capital firms, with a solid understanding of how early-stage companies operate and grow 
 Thrive in fast-moving environments, helping build and scale programs, partnerships, and community initiatives 
 Be highly organized and execution-oriented, able to manage multiple initiatives and stakeholders while delivering high-quality programs 
 Be data-driven, able to track key engagement metrics and communicate the impact of regional initiatives 
 Communicate clearly and confidently with founders, investors, and senior internal stakeholders 
 Operate with a high degree of ownership and initiative, collaborating with a globally distributed team while maintaining an active presence within the India AI startup ecosystem 
 
 About MongoDB 
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. 
 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software. 
 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.  
 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world! 
 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. 
 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
Skape is building the Uber of landscaping - a platform that instantly connects homeowners with top-rated landscaping professionals. We're transforming a $130 billion industry that's still run on phone calls, cash payments, and word-of-mouth referrals.

Founded by a Navy veteran and Columbia CS grad, Skape is a venture-backed startup based in New York. We're live, growing fast, and backed by investors who believe the home services industry is ready for a technology-first approach.

About the Role

Skape is at an inflection point. We've proven product-market fit in our launch markets, and now we need someone who can pour fuel on the fire. As our Growth Marketing Manager, you'll own the entire growth engine - from top-of-funnel awareness to activation, retention, and referral.

This is not a "run some Facebook ads" role. You'll be building growth systems from scratch, running rapid experiments, and working directly with the founder to define our go-to-market strategy as we expand into new markets across the Northeast and beyond.

You'll have real budget, real autonomy, and real impact. Every dollar you spend, every campaign you launch, every experiment you run will directly move the needle on a business that's transforming how 80 million American homeowners care for their properties.

What You'll Do

• Build and execute multi-channel growth strategies across paid social, SEM, SEO, email, SMS, and referral programs
• Own user acquisition targets for both sides of the marketplace (homeowners and landscapers)
• Design and run rapid A/B tests across landing pages, ad creative, messaging, and conversion funnels
• Develop content marketing strategies including blog posts, social media, and community engagement
• Build automated lifecycle marketing campaigns to drive activation, engagement, and retention
• Analyze funnel metrics, cohort data, and LTV/CAC ratios to optimize spend and strategy
• Manage relationships with marketing vendors, agencies, and platform reps
• Create market launch playbooks for new geographic expansions
What We're Looking For
Required

• 4+ years in growth marketing, performance marketing, or demand generation at a startup or tech company
• Proven track record of scaling user acquisition channels from scratch to significant volume
• Deep expertise in at least two of: paid social (Meta/TikTok), SEM (Google Ads), SEO, or email/SMS marketing
• Strong analytical skills - comfortable with SQL, Excel, and analytics tools (Mixpanel, GA4, Amplitude)
• Experience with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot, Braze, Iterable, or similar)
• Data-driven mindset with a bias toward experimentation and rapid iteration
Nice to Have
• Experience marketing a two-sided marketplace or on-demand service
• Background in home services, real estate, or local services marketing
• Experience with influencer marketing, partnerships, or community-led growth
• You've taken a product from 0-1 in terms of marketing - building the brand story from scratch
Why Skape?
We're a small team with big ambitions - your work will be visible and impactful from day one

Early-stage equity - you're not employee #10,000, you're helping build the foundation

Remote-first culture - work from anywhere, async by default, results over hours

Direct impact on a $130B industry that hasn't been disrupted yet

Work with a founder who's been in the trenches - Navy veteran, Columbia CS, led engineering at a Fortune 50 company

• Ground Floor Equity
• Build What Matters
• Grow With Us
• Unlimited PTO - we trust you to manage your time
• $1,000/year conference and learning budget

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager - Tech, AWS Marketing
jobs.excerpt:
The AI agent era is here, and you'll help define how enterprises build with it. Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore are how the world's largest organizations are building AI-native applications and autonomous agents. This is one of the fastest-growing product areas in AWS history, and we need a Product Marketing Manager - Tech who can help shape the narrative and drive launches that land with technical audiences. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of product and storytelling. You'll translate complex AI capabilities into clear, compelling positioning, execute launches that reach developers and architects, and develop the content strategies that build adoption. You'll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and field teams across a portfolio that includes Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and Strands Agents (our open-source agent SDK), learning quickly and contributing meaningfully from day one. This is a high-growth role on a team with direct access to AWS leadership and a front-row seat to the most consequential platform shift since cloud itself. Why This Role * Front-row seat to one of the fastest-moving product areas in AWS: agentic AI is redefining how software gets built * Mentorship from senior marketers and direct collaboration with product GMs and engineering leaders who value marketing as a strategic function * Growing visibility: opportunities to contribute to re:Invent content, analyst briefings, and customer engagements * Real ownership: you'll own launches and positioning for specific products, not just execute tasks handed to you * A team culture that rewards bold thinking, intellectual curiosity, and a bias for action Key job responsibilities * Own positioning and launch execution for specific capabilities within the Bedrock/AgentCore portfolio, from messaging development through launch day and post-launch iteration * Translate complex architectures into customer value: create technical narratives, blogs, demos, and reference content that help builders understand when and how to use agents vs. other AI patterns * Contribute to product strategy by gathering and synthesizing signals from customer conversations, competitive intelligence, analyst feedback, and usage data * Develop expertise in your product area and represent it in field enablement sessions, customer conversations, and internal reviews * Drive adoption with technical audiences: develop and execute content strategies that reach developers, architects, and technical decision-makers through the channels they trust * Partner cross-functionally with product management, developer relations, solutions architecture, and sales to support aligned GTM motions About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. 

Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience - Experience working cross functionally with tech teams - 3+ years in product marketing, technical marketing, developer relations, or product management for technical/infrastructure products - Demonstrated ability to create technical content (blogs, presentations, demos, whitepapers) for developer or technical buyer audiences

You will drive key planning processes, including capacity and quota planning, optimization and expansion strategies, and KPI design and measurement. You will also lead strategic and operational initiatives that improve execution while building experience across complex, high-impact business challenges. 
 At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

 Develop short- and long-term go-to-market strategies by identifying growth opportunities, setting business priorities, and aligning sales and growth targets 
 Own quota planning for the global Sales organization, including building and maintaining quota models, adapting them to organizational changes, and driving stakeholder alignment 
 Analyze sales and go-to-market data to identify trends and channel efficiency, and develop models that inform planning, quota setting, and strategic decisions 
 Partner with Sales and other go-to-market leaders to shape strategic priorities, translate future-state goals into actionable plans, and execute key initiatives 
 Build dashboards and define KPIs that translate complex data into actionable insights for business leaders 
 Lead and support high-priority cross-functional initiatives that improve execution and accelerate revenue growth 
 
 Who You Are: 
 
 You have 2–4 years of experience in go-to-market, growth, or revenue strategy; management consulting; investment banking or equity research; business analysis; or a related field 
 You can break down complex or ambiguous business problems, identify key tradeoffs, and develop clear, actionable recommendations 
 You have strong quantitative modeling and analytical skills, with attention to detail and the ability to communicate key insights to senior business stakeholders 
 You communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including synthesizing complex concepts and developing presentations for senior and executive audiences 
 You have demonstrated the ability to own multiple projects and collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders across functions such as Sales, Marketing, Strategy, and Product 
 You have experience with, or an interest in learning, business intelligence and data analysis tools such as Tableau, Looker, Metabase, SQL, or Python; experience with Sales or Customer Success strategy, SaaS, or high-tech businesses is a plus 
 
 Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

 Employee-focused best in class onboarding

 Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

 Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram , LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

 About Stripe 
 Stripe, LLC. is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 What you’ll do 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Support the Regional sales leaders with intelligence and insight to accelerate growth; 
 Support the Sales Strategy and Operations colleagues by standardizing global and regional common process that is currently decentralized; 
 Provide a deep dive into key performance metrics and drive deep understanding of business performance; 
 Problem solve and provide structure analysis outcomes for complex sales operations challenges through data, analytics and insight; 
 Identify new opportunities and areas of productivity efficiency gains for Regional sales leadership; 
 Participate in projects defining go-to-market approaches, as well as in regular business and resource planning.  
 Run analysis on key performance metrics, and provide relevant insights for managing the business; 
 Oversee the implementation of enabling systems and tools, and work closely with internal systems teams; 
 Prepare weekly senior leader forecast materials and provide ongoing updates on key business growth/metrics to leadership teams; and 
 Manage bespoke projects and effectively manage stakeholders. 
 
 Who you are 
 Minimum requirements 
 Must have a Bachelor's Degree or foreign equivalent degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Management and Systems, or a related field, plus seven (7) years of related experience in Sales, Strategy, and Operations, of which at least five (5) years must be post-bachelor's progressive work experience. In the alternative, the employer is willing to accept a Master's Degree or foreign equivalent degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Management and Systems, or a related field, plus five (5) years of related work experience in Sales, Strategy, and Operations.

 SQL and other advanced analytic tools to develop and run complex SQL queries and analyze large data sets; 
 BI visualization tools, including Tableau; and 
 Working with data and large data sets to identify trends and create insights to make recommendations to senior leaders. 
 
 Must also have four (4) years of experience with the following: 
 
 Using AI to improve productivity and reduce manual processes, and automated reporting dashboards. 
 
 Must also have three (3) years of experience with each of the following: 
 
 Manage cross-functional stakeholders and managing expectations and timelines; and 
 Working with and manipulating large data sets to deliver deep analyses and actionable insights. 
 
 Multiple positions available.

 This salary range represents the base salary range for the role and any sales commissions /sales bonuses targets, if applicable, would be in addition to the base salary. 
 40 hrs/week

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
ABOUT US:

AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.

Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.

We recently raised a $355M Series C https://modal.com/blog/modal-series-c at a $4.65B valuation, led by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures. We've crossed $300M+ ARR and grown fivefold since September.

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.

THE ROLE:

We're hiring a Field Marketing Manager in San Francisco to build and run the programs that turn Modal's target accounts into active customers. You'll work closely with our Sales team to plan regional campaigns, run events for the engineers and technical leaders we sell to, and report on how those programs contribute to pipeline and revenue. This is a hands-on role for someone who has run account-based field programs at a technical company and wants to help shape the function as it grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Act as a strategic partner to Sales, aligning field programs with sales priorities and helping AEs create and accelerate pipeline in their territories.

 - Develop and execute account-based programs for named accounts, working with Sales to identify key stakeholders and the right mix of touchpoints for each.

 - Decide which industry conferences and sponsorships are worth investing in. Own what we bring, who we send, and whether we go back next year.

 - Plan and host high-touch 1:1 and 1:few events for prospects and customers, such as executive dinners, roundtables, and technical workshops, in partnership with AEs.

 - Own pre-event and post-event execution, including targeted invitations, meeting booking, and timely follow-up with Sales.

 - Build co-marketing programs with VCs, accelerators, and ecosystem partners to reach their portfolio companies and customers.

 - Track and report on program performance, including meetings booked, account engagement, and sourced and influenced pipeline, and use the results to plan future investment.

 - Own the VIP experience at Modal's flagship events, including our annual conference, Runtime.

 - Build repeatable processes and playbooks as the team grows.

REQUIREMENTS:

 - A track record running field programs at a technical company. You can point to specific ones and clear outcomes.

 - You've worked directly with AEs and you're happy sharing a number with them.

 - Good judgment about where to spend. A lot of sponsorships look better than they perform, and you can tell which is which. Experience in AI or developer tools helps here.

 - Organized and self-directed. This role runs many events, partners, and vendors at once.

 - Experience producing events across a range of formats, from small executive dinners to large conference sponsorships and brand events.

 - Strong attention to detail and a high bar for taste and the quality of every event and touchpoint.

 - Comfort with data and reporting, including CRM, attribution, and pipeline analysis.

 - Familiarity with ABM, intent data, and marketing automation tools.

 - Experience building AI into marketing workflows, such as account research, audience development, event operations, and reporting.

NICE-TO-HAVE:

 - Experience at an AI, developer tools, or cloud infrastructure company.

 - Experience marketing to technical audiences such as engineers, ML teams, and technical executives.

 - Experience bridging product-led and sales-assisted growth.

 - Existing relationships with Bay Area VCs, accelerators, or AI communities.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative II, Local Independent Grocery - Boston
jobs.excerpt:
We're transforming the grocery industry 
 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. 
 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. 
 Instacart is a Flex First team 
 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. OVERVIEW 
 As we continue our rapid growth, we are looking to grow our Local Independent Grocery team within Strategic Partnerships. We are hiring a Sales Development Representative to identify, contact, and qualify independent retailers as potential partners for Instacart, as well as close small business opportunities.The Sales Development Representative will play a critical role in managing leads through the pipeline by setting meetings, following up with prospects, and driving progress toward partnership goals. 
 We are seeking someone with excellent communication skills, a strong work ethic, and a proven track record of success in sales or business development. If you are a self-motivated individual with a passion for building impactful partnerships and supporting the success of independent retailers, we encourage you to apply. 
 About the Team: 
 The Sales Development Representative (SDR) team is focused on engaging independent retailers and setting meetings to help them explore the opportunities available on the Instacart Marketplace. By building strong relationships and identifying retailers ready to grow their online presence, SDRs play a vital role in connecting businesses to Instacart’s platform. Whether working with grocery, alcohol, or other retail businesses, the team is dedicated to helping retailers expand their reach and meet the needs of their customers through Instacart’s ecosystem. 
   
 ABOUT THE JOB 
 
 Prospect and engage independent retailers to join the Instacart Marketplace. 
 Opportunity to manage the end-to-end sales cycle for small opportunities 
 Use cold calls and emails to identify new opportunities, drive value, and establish meaningful relationships with local retailers. 
 Strong problem-solving, solution mapping and negotiation skills 
 Time management and organizational skills with the ability to prioritize a strong go to market strategy  
 Work independently while collaborating with the team to achieve individual and team objectives. 
 Flexibility and adaptability to change 
 A strong desire to learn and grow in the sales field 
 strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively engage retailers and convey Instacart’s value proposition. 
 Developing sales collateral, case studies, and custom ‘stories’ to translate benefits of Instacart’s platform to independent retailers 

 ABOUT YOU 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 
 Previous experience in a sales or business development role  
 Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to build rapport and establish lasting relationships. 
 Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and KPIs. 
 Excellent organizational and project management skills. 
 Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and quality. 
 Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic environment. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
 Strong knowledge of the grocery industry, including market trends and operational challenges.  
 Experience selling SaaS solutions to drive retailer success is a plus. 
 Familiarity with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) and sales engagement tools. 
 
 #LI-Remote Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here . 
 Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please rea d more about our benefits offerings here . jobs.title: Strategic Marketing Analyst - Coating Services
jobs.excerpt:
PPG is looking for a Strategic Marketing Analyst to join our team! You will support the Coatings Services growth strategy through market intelligence, customer insights, competitive analysis, and strategic opportunity assessment. You will identify where and how the business should grow by providing actionable insights on markets, industries, customers, competitors, and emerging opportunities. You will work closely with Commercial Excellence, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Leadership to support diversification efforts, pipeline growth, strategic account targeting, and long-term business planning. A key responsibility of this role is to build strong partnerships across PPG business units to identify opportunities where Coatings Services can leverage existing customer relationships, market presence, technologies, and industry expertise to accelerate growth in priority markets. You will report to the Senior Manager of Commercial Excellence and Marketing and work a hybrid schedule at either our Pittsburgh, PA office or Troy, Michigan Office.

Key Responsibilities

jobs.title: Social & Content Marketing, Stripe Crypto
jobs.excerpt:
About Privy 
 Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails. 
 Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives. 
 Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone 
 What you’ll do 
 We’re looking for an exceptional social and content marketer to help shape how some of the most important products in crypto show up on the internet. 
 This is a hybrid role: part social lead, part writer and editor, part content strategist. You’ll own how Privy, Bridge, and Stripe Crypto show up across social, primarily on X and LinkedIn, while developing content that extends beyond the feed. 
 You’ll turn product launches, customer stories, technical concepts, and industry conversations into sharp, compelling content across short- and long-form formats. You’ll work closely with the Head of Marketing and broader marketing team to find the stories worth telling, partnering with Product, Engineering, and other teams to bring them to life. 
 This is a high-ownership role for someone with exceptional writing instincts, strong editorial judgment, and a deep understanding of how great technology brands show up online. 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Own social across Privy, Bridge, and Stripe Crypto, from editorial planning and drafting through publishing and engagement, primarily across X and LinkedIn. 
 Turn complex products and technical concepts into sharp, accessible stories, partnering across Marketing, Product, and Engineering to understand what we’re building and why it matters. 
 Develop content across short- and long-form formats, from social posts and threads to blog posts, explainers, customer stories, and event coverage. 
 Build and evolve distinct voices across brands and channels, ensuring our content is clear, confident, technically credible, and native to each platform. 
 Stay close to crypto, fintech, and developer communities, identifying conversations, emerging narratives, and cultural moments where we have something meaningful to contribute. 
 Bring a social-first lens to launches and campaigns, helping shape the story, format, and creative approach from the beginning. 
 Experiment with new formats, including short-form video, product demos, graphics, and other platform-native content, creating scrappily or working with creative partners when needed. 
 Surface community insights across Marketing and Product, including what’s resonating, what people are asking, and where conversations are shifting. 
 Use performance and qualitative signals to improve our content strategy, while building scalable systems for editorial planning, publishing, and measurement. 
 
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. 
 Minimum requirements 
 
 4+ years of experience across social, content marketing, editorial, brand, or adjacent roles in technology, fintech, crypto, or other fast-moving industries. 
 An exceptional writer and editor who can move comfortably between a sharp X post, a thoughtful LinkedIn post, and a substantive long-form piece. 
 Strong editorial judgment and taste: you know what makes a story interesting, what belongs on which platform, and when an idea needs a different format entirely. 
 Deep fluency in X and LinkedIn, including how audiences, formats, and conversations differ across platforms. 
 Comfortable going deep on technical concepts and translating them into clear, compelling content without losing accuracy or nuance. 
 Strong instincts for internet-native storytelling and emerging formats. You don’t need to be a professional video editor or designer, but you know what good looks like and can find scrappy ways to bring ideas to life. 
 A strong cross-functional collaborator who asks sharp questions, synthesizes quickly, and can turn incomplete inputs into strong finished work. 
 Analytical and curious: you care about why something worked, not just how many impressions it received, and use those learnings to make the next thing better. 
 Self-directed, collaborative, and adaptable: you thrive in fast-moving environments, navigate ambiguity well, and are comfortable owning work from idea through publication. 
 
 Strong plus 
 
 Experience working in crypto, fintech, developer tools, or another technically complex category. 
 Existing fluency in crypto and stablecoins, and an understanding of the communities and conversations that shape the industry. 
 Experience creating or commissioning short-form video, product demos, motion, or other multimedia content. 
 Experience operating across multiple brands, products, or audiences while maintaining distinct voices and editorial strategies.

jobs.title: Event Marketing Manager - Global Sponsorships (NAMER/LATAM)
jobs.excerpt:
We are a fast-moving, analytically driven B2B marketing team. We show innovative companies how they can improve their applications and get to market faster. We do hundreds of events, thousands of marketing campaigns, research and evangelize ideas that move our industry forward, and more. We are a team of innovators that take exciting and unexpected ideas and bring them to life – and have fun while doing it! 
 Datadog is seeking an Event Marketing Manager to join our high-performing team and support third-party events and tradeshows across the North America and Latin America regions. As a key member of Datadog's Event Marketing team – the driving force behind our high-impact, experiential marketing programs – you will play a critical role in executing best-in-class events that generate leads, pipeline, and scale our brand presence. With hundreds of events run globally each year, this role requires someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of delivering high-quality event experiences, consistently meeting deadlines, and collaborating cross-functionally. If you're passionate about creating impactful brand experiences and excited to help shape Datadog's event footprint across NAMER & LATAM, we'd love to hear from you! 
 At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. 
 What You'll Do: 
 
 Lead Datadog's end-to-end presence at large-scale third-party (sponsored) events in North America & LATAM regions, including strategy, planning, logistics, onsite execution, staffing, audience engagement, and performance measurement. 
 Uphold high standards for live event experiences, ensuring strong brand alignment and delivering programs accountable for measurable pipeline contribution — leads generated, opportunities influenced, and pipeline created — with every investment decision defensible with data. 
 Evaluate sponsorship packages and make activation investment decisions (tier selection, add-ons, what to cut) grounded in pipeline return; support contract preparation, negotiation, and vendor management. 
 Leverage AI tools to accelerate event research, vendor evaluation, briefing documents, post-event reporting, and stakeholder communications — improving speed and quality of outputs. 
 Partner closely with broader Marketing teams to ensure cohesive regional planning and integrated execution. 
 Collaborate with NAMER and LATAM teams on regional initiatives, share best practices, align workflows, and support select events across regions. 
 Enhance operational workflows by improving planning processes, lead capture mechanisms, reporting templates, and execution frameworks. 
 Track, analyze, and report on event KPIs, ROI, and budget accuracy; ensure data integrity and timely post-event follow-up. 
 Identify new event opportunities, market trends, and innovative experiential approaches to strengthen Datadog's presence in NAMER and LATAM. 
 Model calm, professional behavior in high-pressure situations and help foster a positive, proactive, and collaborative team environment. 
 Manage event logistics including vendor sourcing, booth configuration, shipping, asset coordination, and onsite operations. 
 Ensure seamless onsite execution through detailed planning, strong contingency management, and confident troubleshooting. 
 Travel up to 50% to support events in NAMER and LATAM. 
 
 Who You Are: 
 
 4-6 years of event management experience in a high-tech, B2B, or fast-paced environment managing lead-generating events. 
 Experience running concurrent, multi-faceted events. 
 Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple events, deadlines, and budgets simultaneously. 
 Able to stay calm and professional in high-stress, fast-changing event environments. 
 Comfortable partnering closely with Sales and Product teams, resolving onsite issues, and communicating clearly with internal and external stakeholders. 
 Highly detail-oriented with strong reporting and analytical skills; proficiency with Salesforce, Tableau, Metabase, or similar tools required. 
 Comfortable using AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) in daily workflows; curious about applying AI to streamline event planning, lead enrichment, and reporting. 
 Positive, proactive, team-oriented, and able to work independently with minimal oversight. 
 Comfortable with flexible hours, including evenings/weekends during event cycles. 
 Able to lift up to 25 lbs and stand for extended periods during events. 
 
 Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. 
 Benefits & Growth: 
 
 Generous and competitive benefits package 
 New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan 
 Continuous career development and pathing opportunities 
 Employee-focused best in class onboarding 
 Internal mentor and cross-departmental buddy program 
 Friendly and inclusive workplace culture 
 
 Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog. 
 #LI-Hybrid Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan. The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is: $91,000 — $121,000 USD 
 About Datadog:  
 Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram , LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center. 
 
 Equal Opportunity at Datadog: 
 Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our Candidate Legal Notices for your reference.  
 Datadog endeavors to make our Careers Page accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please complete this form . This form is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.  
 Privacy and AI Guidelines: 
 Any information you submit to Datadog as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Datadog’s  Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice . For information on our AI policy, please visit Interviewing at Datadog AI Guidelines .

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, Thailand
jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Stripe, you'll support some of the region's largest and most innovative companies across various industries. You'll help power Stripe's growth engine by partnering closely with the Demand Generation and Account Executive teams to qualify leads and build a high-quality sales pipeline. You thrive on engaging with prospects, uncovering their needs, and identifying high-value opportunities. You're skilled at navigating early-stage sales conversations and energized by both learning new products and articulating their value in complex scenarios. 
 You also enjoy building—whether it's improving the demand generation and sales processes, sharpening how we communicate Stripe's value, or creating tools and assets that help the team scale. If you're hungry, curious, persistent, and a strong team player, we'd love to hear from you. 
 For the first months, you'll be part of the Sales Development Associate program, which is designed to accelerate your onboarding and ramp to full productivity as an SDR. This intensive program is built to help you quickly build and develop skills required to be successful in this role. Upon completion, you'll continue learning and growing in your career as part of Stripe's Sales Development Academy. These programs are endorsed and supported by sales leaders as an important part of investing in our people. 
 We take a data-driven, problem-solving approach to sales development, and look for someone who is confident in both prospecting to customers and in helping design our strategy. 
 What you’ll do 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Research and create outreach materials for high-value prospects, in partnership with SDRs and AEs 
 Follow up with Marketing-generated leads to qualify as sales opportunities. Move solid leads through the funnel connecting them to a salesperson, and arranging meetings 
 Execute outbound sales plays created by Marketing 
 Initiate contact with potential customers through cold-calling or responding to inquiries generated from Marketing 
 Develop relationships with prospects to uncover needs through effective questioning to qualify interest and viability to prepare hand-off to sales 
 Follow up with potential customers who expressed interest but did not initially result in a sales opportunity 
 Effectively work through lead list meeting and exceeding service-level agreements, consistently update activity and contact information within the CRM system, and support weekly reporting efforts 
 Collaborate and provide feedback and insights to Marketing to help improve targeting and messaging 
 Prospect into enterprises of all sizes across the APAC region using a variety of tools and outreach methods 
 
 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
 
 A track record of top performance or prior success in academic, extracurricular, or professional endeavors 
 Superior verbal and written communication skills, with an ability to clearly articulate complex topics 
 Self-starter who is highly motivated and able to operate effectively and autonomously in a hyper-growth environment 
 This role requires in-office participation three (3) days per week in our Sydney office. 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 
 Professional experience in a sales, customer service, or fast-paced professional environment 
 
 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (Spanish fluency)
jobs.excerpt:
About the team 
 Note: This role is an in-office position, based in our Chicago, IL office. 
 As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Stripe, you’ll work in a customer-facing role focused on connecting prospective customers with Stripe. You will work in partnership with the Marketing and Sales teams to create a high quality, predictable pipeline. We hire and train SDRs in a way that prepares them to be a high performing source of talent for Stripe Sales and Go to Market teams.  
 What you’ll do 
 For the first few months, you’ll be a part of our Sales Development Associate program , which is designed to accelerate onboarding and support new grads transition into their first roles in a corporate setting. Part of this period will be supported by the Sales Development Academy which  will help you quickly build and develop the foundational skills required to be successful in this role and position you for a long-term career in Sales at Stripe. Through a mix of virtual sessions, in-person practicums, and check-point quizzes, you’ll learn all about Stripe’s products and how to be a successful SDR. During this period you’ll also be partnered with a senior SDR on the team as a mentor. Along with your manager, your mentor will be there as an additional resource to help support you.  
 Within a few weeks of starting at Stripe you'll be reaching out to potential Stripe customers, pitching them on the products that could best support their business model, and partnering with senior sellers on the team who will ultimately help close deals. We take a data driven approach to the role and the success of our SDRs is largely dependent on their successful outreach to new Stripe customers.  
 While onboarding spans across the course of your first few weeks at Stripe, the Academy offers continued training and enablement over the course of your first year as an SDR to ensure top performers are set up for a successful transition to other roles on the sales team. Most regularly we see our top performing SDRs promoted into Account Executive roles.  
 If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, interacting with customers, and being responsible for generating revenue, we’d love to hear from you!  
 Responsibilities 
 
 Contact potential customers through cold-calling, email, and social channels, or by responding to inquiries generated from Marketing activities. 
 Book meetings with potential customers (prospects) and pitch them on Stripe’s products that are a match for their business model.  
 Develop relationships with prospects to uncover specific business needs through effective, consultative questioning to qualify interest and prepare a comprehensive hand-off to sales. 
 Research and create compelling outreach materials for high-value prospects, in partnership with SDRs and Account Executives. 
 Execute outbound sales outreach created by marketing, leveraging strategic messaging to target specific segments. 
 Follow-up with potential customers who expressed interest but did not initially result in a sales opportunity, maintaining a warm pipeline. 
 Effectively manage customer outreach, consistently meeting/exceeding Service Level Agreements (SLAs), meticulously updating activity and contact information within the Customer Relationship Management system (Salesforce) to support weekly reporting efforts. 
 Collaborate and provide essential feedback and insights to Marketing to help improve targeting, messaging, and overall campaign effectiveness. 
 
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. 
 Minimum requirements 
 
 Superior verbal and written communication skills in BOTH English and Spanish 
 A track record of top performance or prior success in academic, extracurricular, or professional endeavors. 
 Self-starter who is highly motivated and able to operate effectively and autonomously in a hyper-growth environment. 
 This role requires in-office participation three to four (3-4) days per week in our Chicago office. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
 Professional experience in a sales, customer service, or fast-paced professional environment.

jobs.title: Regional Revenue Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
The Regional Revenue Marketing Manager will help drive account expansion and deal acceleration through integrated regional marketing programs, with Sales as a primary stakeholder. As a key marketing partner for assigned AMER markets, you’ll collaborate with sales and marketing to build and execute programs that engage decision makers, advance buying committees, accelerate the sales cycle, and improve conversion to customers. You’ll experiment with new approaches and tools while applying a disciplined, analytical approach to measuring program performance and business impact. You are a data-guided, results-driven marketer and collaborative partner to cross-functional stakeholders. 
 We're looking to speak with candidates based in Chicago or Minneapolis for our hybrid working model. 
 Position Expectations 
 
 Contribute to and execute the field marketing plan for assigned AMER markets, in partnership with regional marketing leadership and Sales. The integrated plan may include digital programs, web and webinars, trade shows, regional events, pipeline acceleration events, and the annual roadshow, in concert with key customers and partners in the region 
 Build and execute decision-maker programs that engage executives, business leaders, technical leaders, and other influential personas across strategic accounts 
 Partner with account teams to understand account priorities, buying committees, decision-making processes, whitespace opportunities, and barriers to expansion; translate those insights into relevant programs and experiences 
 Develop and coordinate account-focused programs that support enterprise opportunities, strengthen relationships with key decision makers, and help create momentum through the sales cycle 
 Work with the wider organization to support strategies that expand usage of MongoDB across enterprise accounts and across personas, from developers to C-level executives 
 Support developer groundswell initiatives within assigned markets and contribute to tracking and reporting on developers enabled in the region 
 Generate programs that contribute to pipeline, account expansion, and net annual recurring revenue (NARR), and track and report on results 
 Be a trusted partner to regional Sales leadership and account teams by understanding territory needs and executing marketing strategies and programs that support deal velocity 
 Conduct market and account research to identify regional opportunities, relevant audiences, and effective engagement strategies 
 Work closely with regional marketing managers and cross-functional partners across AMER to align plans with Sales and Marketing goals and objectives 
 Ensure program performance, pipeline influence, and ROI are tracked consistently; use insights to optimize programs and improve outcomes 
 Support flagship events, sponsored conferences, regional events, and customer or executive experiences 
 Manage budgets for assigned programs and markets, ensuring thoughtful allocation and accurate tracking of spend and results

 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. 
 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. 
 Instacart is a Flex First team 
 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. OVERVIEW 
 As we continue our rapid growth, we are looking to grow our Local Independent Grocery team within Strategic Partnerships. We are hiring a Sales Development Representative to identify, contact, and qualify independent retailers as potential partners for Instacart, as well as close small business opportunities.The Sales Development Representative will play a critical role in managing leads through the pipeline by setting meetings, following up with prospects, and driving progress toward partnership goals. 
 We are seeking someone with excellent communication skills, a strong work ethic, and a proven track record of success in sales or business development. If you are a self-motivated individual with a passion for building impactful partnerships and supporting the success of independent retailers, we encourage you to apply. 
 About the Team: 
 The Sales Development Representative (SDR) team is focused on engaging independent retailers and setting meetings to help them explore the opportunities available on the Instacart Marketplace. By building strong relationships and identifying retailers ready to grow their online presence, SDRs play a vital role in connecting businesses to Instacart’s platform. Whether working with grocery, alcohol, or other retail businesses, the team is dedicated to helping retailers expand their reach and meet the needs of their customers through Instacart’s ecosystem. 
   
 ABOUT THE JOB 
 
 Prospect and engage independent retailers to join the Instacart Marketplace. 
 Opportunity to manage the end-to-end sales cycle for small opportunities 
 Use cold calls and emails to identify new opportunities, drive value, and establish meaningful relationships with local retailers. 
 Strong problem-solving, solution mapping and negotiation skills 
 Time management and organizational skills with the ability to prioritize a strong go to market strategy  
 Work independently while collaborating with the team to achieve individual and team objectives. 
 Flexibility and adaptability to change 
 A strong desire to learn and grow in the sales field 
 strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively engage retailers and convey Instacart’s value proposition. 
 Developing sales collateral, case studies, and custom ‘stories’ to translate benefits of Instacart’s platform to independent retailers 

 ABOUT YOU 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 
 Previous experience in a sales or business development role  
 Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to build rapport and establish lasting relationships. 
 Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and KPIs. 
 Excellent organizational and project management skills. 
 Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and quality. 
 Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic environment. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
 Strong knowledge of the grocery industry, including market trends and operational challenges.  
 Experience selling SaaS solutions to drive retailer success is a plus. 
 Familiarity with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) and sales engagement tools.

jobs.title: Product Quality Analyst, Worldwide Grocery Stores Private Brands Product Quality
jobs.excerpt:
The Worldwide Grocery Private Brands team is looking for a Product Quality Manager who is passionate about ensuring our products meet or exceed customer expectations. You will join a dynamic, fast-paced, collaborative work environment where you will help build and scale our business across physical stores and online channels in North America. This role ensures that products are consistently produced and meet our quality expectations. You will drive activities across several stakeholder teams including Product Development, Category Managers, Food Safety, Marketing, Supply Chain, Operations, and suppliers to ensure the maintenance of quality expectations for our food and other CPG items. The position focuses on monitoring product performance of launched products, managing trend analysis, customer complaint issue identification, and facilitating product and process improvement initiatives with suppliers and internal cross-functional teams. This is a hands-on role that combines product quality management with laboratory work. In addition to driving quality programs, you will conduct and oversee quality assurance testing, including first production testing, shelf-life verification, and consumer complaint investigations, while maintaining accurate documentation, laboratory equipment, and retention sample inventory. You will also leverage data and mechanisms to identify defects, track quality performance, and drive improvements that maintain customer trust in our brands and products. The right person for this role must be customer obsessed and enjoy using data and mechanisms to drive improvements. The successful candidate will be self-motivated, comfortable working with data and identifying trends from large data sets, have high attention to detail, a strong vision for quality standards and programs, and the ability to develop sound recommendations for product and process improvements. This candidate must be able to build and maintain strong working relationships across teams, earn trust and influence others, be solution oriented, have solid problem-solving skills, communicate clearly (verbal and written) with technical and non-technical teams alike, and be motivated by a fast-paced dynamic environment. Key job responsibilities - Support a robust product quality program across both pre-launch and post-launch initiatives. - Conduct and oversee laboratory quality testing, including first production testing, shelf-life verification, and consumer complaint investigations; execute testing protocols and document results accurately in designated quality data management systems, adhering to standard operating procedures and safety protocols. - Maintain laboratory equipment, perform calibration, and manage retention sample inventory and storage monitoring. - Support the Quality Surveillance program to monitor product performance post-launch, analyzing large sets of customer feedback data (ratings, concessions, complaints) to identify product, process, and supplier improvement opportunities and drive improvement initiatives. - Support business selection health assessments, influencing cross-functional teams based on quality performance metrics to drive remediation, reformulation, or product discontinuation decisions. - Use and help optimize quality dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track program, product, and supplier performance metrics. A day in the life No two days look exactly alike in this role, but most blend hands-on lab work with product quality program management. You might start your morning in the laboratory, running first-production or shelf-life testing on newly launched items and documenting results in our quality systems, then shift to reviewing customer feedback trends (ratings, concessions, and complaints) to spot emerging quality issues. Throughout the week, you will partner closely with a product category, supporting the product quality development of new items from early formulation through launch, helping ensure quality requirements are built in from the start. By midday, you could be working with Product Development, Food Safety, or a supplier on a defect investigation or a business selection health assessment, translating what the data and the bench tell you into concrete remediation or reformulation recommendations. Afternoons often involve maintaining lab equipment and retention samples, refining a quality dashboard, or preparing performance metrics to influence cross-functional decisions. Throughout, you will balance the precision of laboratory testing with the bigger-picture work of keeping our food and other CPG items meeting the quality standards our customers expect. About the team Our team is dedicated to identifying and mitigating WWGS PB product quality risks that protect Amazon's customers, partners, and operations. We work collaboratively across the organization to build and refine the processes, controls, and mechanisms that keep our business compliant and resilient. We value curiosity, clear communication, and a commitment to continuous improvement. As we look ahead, we are focused on scaling our programs and integrating new tools and approaches to stay ahead of emerging challenges. Joining our team means contributing to work that has a direct, meaningful impact on trust and quality at Amazon.

Basic qualifications:
- Experience in the Quality Assurance/testing domain - Experience performing accurate data entry and analysis - Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time - Experience handling ambiguous or undefined challenges through strong problem solving abilities - 2+ years of experience in product or program management, product development, or quality management of food and other CPG items. - Hands-on experience with laboratory equipment and food testing methodologies (physical, chemical, or microbiological). - Experience with laboratory equipment maintenance and calibration, and retention sample inventory management. - Strong analytical skills, including the ability to distill, synthesize, and draw conclusions from large amounts of data. - Experience in analyzing customer feedback data and trend analysis. - Excellent communicator (written, oral, presentation), comfortable communicating with technical and non-technical team members. - Proven track record for cultivating strong relationships with key internal and external partners. - Ability to drive decisions under time pressure without compromising safety or compliance of products. - 2+ years of experience using Microsoft Excel. - Bachelor's degree or above

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations across leadership and cross-functional teams - Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Chemistry, Biology, or a related field. - Knowledge of HACCP and food safety systems. - Food manufacturing quality assurance experience, site operations, or site quality controls. - Familiarity with food industry regulations, standards, and quality management systems. - Experience with Private Brands or consumer goods manufacturing, preferably in regulated spaces. - Experience leveraging AI tools, including validating quality of output. - Diversified experience with the entire product lifecycle and supply chain (R&D, scale-up, material sourcing, operations management, customer feedback). - Experience with continuous improvement programs and procedures. - Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence, or experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Creator Campaign Manager
jobs.excerpt:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Creator Campaign Manager to join the SpaceXAI creator marketing team on-site in San Francisco. Our team leads creator and talent partnerships across the SpaceX product suite, running scaled programs across platforms, social channels, and content formats.

This role owns creator campaigns end to end, from strategy and sourcing through negotiation, briefing, execution, and payment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Manage multiple creator campaigns simultaneously, keeping deliverables, budgets, and timelines on track.

 - Develop campaigns across platforms and content formats based on each product’s goals and audience.

 - Source and evaluate creators based on audience, content quality, brand fit, and campaign objectives.

 - Lead negotiations on rates, deliverables, usage rights, and partnership terms.

 - Manage contracting, approvals, invoicing, and creator payouts in partnership with legal, procurement, and finance.

 - Translate complex product capabilities into clear, compelling creator briefs.

 - Review content and provide actionable feedback that maintains a high creative bar.

 - Manage agency partners, holding them accountable for execution, quality, and results.

 - Build and maintain a high volume of direct creator relationships.

 - Track campaign performance and apply learnings to future partnerships.

 - Support creator events and activations as needed.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3–5 years of influencer marketing experience at a brand-facing agency or in-house on a brand’s influencer marketing team.

 - Strong command of the fundamentals: sourcing, negotiation, contracting, briefing, project management, and payments.

 - Experience executing scaled programs with a high volume of concurrent partnerships.

 - At least two years managing external partners, either overseeing agencies in-house or managing multiple brand accounts at an agency.

 - Strong negotiation skills and confidence navigating creator and talent relationships.

 - Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.

 - A high bar for creative taste and the ability to give clear, constructive feedback.

 - Experience across multiple social platforms preferred, particularly Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn.

 - Ideally, experience working with tech brands and translating complex products into accessible creator content.

 - Some experience supporting creator events or activations.

 - Based in, or willing to relocate to, San Francisco; in-person

jobs.excerpt:
Agency

Flywheel

Job Function

Account Management and Growth

Job Subfunction

Growth

Job Description

About Flywheel

Flywheel's suite of digital commerce solutions accelerate growth across all major digital marketplaces for the world's leading brands. We give clients access to near real-time performance measurement and improve sales, share, and profit. With teams across the Americas, Europe and APAC, we offer a career with real impact, endless growth opportunities and the support you need to be the best you can be.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an Manager, Marketing Operations & AI to join our team as part of our Sales function. This role will play a critical role in optimizing our sales AI-powered technology stack & it’s integrations, supporting Sales team pipeline campaigns, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the revenue organization.

This role requires significant experience with Salesforce, HubSpot (Marketing & Sales Hub), other GTM technologies, and the ability to partner with sales, marketing and RevOps stakeholders to drive operational excellence. This is an exciting opportunity for a detail-oriented, tech-savvy individual who is passionate about building scalable processes, leveraging AI, and bridging the gap between sales & marketing. You’ll have the chance to shape how we utilize tools, data, and AI-automation to accelerate growth.

What You Will Do

In this role, you’ll support and enhance our Sales support infrastructure to ensure the effectiveness of our demand generation and revenue programs. Responsibilities include:

Support, optimize, and troubleshoot various Sales tooling & it’s AI capabilities, ensuring team members can work effectively.

Build, maintain, and optimize AI workflows, lead flows, and scoring frameworks to improve funnel health.

Maintain integrations between HubSpot, Salesforce, and other tools to ensure data accuracy and consistency.

Enable AI-supported campaign execution by aligning marketing signals with sales actions.

Partner with the Marketing & Demand Generation teams to support campaign execution

Work with RevOps to build performance reporting, including pipeline attribution and ROI analysis.

Assist with data hygiene projects across various data sources, ensuring accurate lead, contact, and account information.

Identify opportunities for process improvements and automation across the Sales function.

Partner with Sales Operations to align on lead routing, qualification, and reporting.

Who You Are

3+ years of hands-on Sales or Marketing Operations experience, with expert-level HubSpot (Marketing Hub), Salesforce, and AI knowledge.

Proven ability to deploy AI-powered automation across GTM workflows (lead routing, enrichment, follow-ups, task creation), CRM integrations (Salesforce), and Sales engagements.

Experience using AI for pipeline analysis, forecasting support, and deal risk identification

Deep understanding of lead management, scoring, routing, and pipeline development.

Experience with BI/reporting tools is a plus.

Experience with basic coding/scripting (SQL, Python, Javascript, APIs (Postman), Version Control (Git) is a plus.

Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively collaborate internally with colleagues and externally with clients.

Team player with a genuine desire to contribute to the overall success of the entire team.

Flywheel Commerce Network is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.

$65,000 CAD - $80,000 CAD - This position is commission eligible.

Working at Flywheel

We are proud to offer all Flywheelers a competitive rewards package and unparalleled career growth opportunities and a supportive, fun and engaging culture.

We have office hubs across the globe where team members can go to feel productive, inspired, and connected to others - team members go into Hub Offices 3x a week

Competitive paid time off, including annual leave plus paid public holidays

Great learning and development opportunities

Benefits that help you live your best life

Parental leave and benefits

Volunteering opportunities

If you’re looking to connect with teammates on a topic of inclusion and identity, chances are there’s an ERG for that.

So you know: The hired candidate will be required to complete a background check

The Interview Process

Every role starts the same, an introductory call with someone from our Talent Acquisition team. We will be looking for company and values-fit as well as your professional experience; there may be some technical role-specific questions during this call.

Every role is different after the initial call, but you can expect to meet several people from the team 1:1 and there might be further skill assessments in the form of a Take Home Assignment/Case Study Presentation or Pair Programming/Live Coding exercise depending on the role. In your initial call, we will walk you through exactly what to expect the process to be.

Inclusive Workforce

Flywheel Commerce Network’s goal is to create a culture where all individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable in bringing their authentic selves to work. We want all people to feel included and empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Flywheel Commerce Network is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-Verify. All applicants will receive fair consideration for employment. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the application and interview process, please let us know at recruitment@flywheeldigital.com so that we can support you.

For more information about what data we collect and how we use it, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

We leverage AI technology to streamline our hiring workflow, though all candidate decisions are made by our Talent Acquisition Team. This position is for an existing vacancy.

IMPORTANT ALERT: Please beware of fraudulent job communications from individuals falsely claiming to be from Flywheel. We've identified fraudulent activity through social media and messaging services purporting to be from Flywheel requesting payments for job- and recruitment-related expenses. Flywheel never asks candidates for personal information such as bank account data or tax IDs nor payments via social media or chat-based applications. Report suspected fraud to local authorities immediately. To learn more, click here.

Please note, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party Recruitment Firms. $65,000 CAD - $80,000 CAD - This position is commission eligible.

resume_core.summary: Product Marketing Manager with 6+ years across enterprise B2B SaaS, fintech, and AI platforms, and an MBA in Business Analytics and Machine Learning.
